messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — the calendar event for tomorrow's orientation points to the internal Zoom (the hosted-api deep-dive room). APAC folks just pinged me that it shows 3:30am local for them 😬
Samir Patel: Oof. Can we add a separate recurring event for an APAC-friendly repeat? Also what’s the recording retention policy for these sessions — I might need to watch later.
onboarding-bot: onboarding-bot created meeting 'New Hire Orientation - APAC Repeat' • scheduled 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/9876543210  Passcode: 4268
Jordan Lee: I can spin up a separate Outlook/Exchange invite so it shows properly in Outlook/Exchange calendars. Also good to attach an .ics for folks who import manually. Example .ics snippet below you can attach to the event:
```
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Redwood Inference//Onboarding//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:20260402T220000-9832@redwood.com
DTSTAMP:20260402T220000Z
DTSTART:20260402T220000Z
DTEND:20260402T233000Z
SUMMARY:New Hire Orientation - APAC Repeat
DESCRIPTION:Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/9876543210 Passcode:4268
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```
Elena Torres: @Maya thanks for catching. Can we request longer recording retention? Legal sometimes asks for 6 months for onboarding records.
Maya Chen: Filed an eng-ops ticket to extend retention to 180 days for these orientation recordings. For now I'll post the recording to this channel + the onboarding drive once it's processed. ETA ~1 hour after meeting.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup: One more timezone edge-case — some hires are in AZ (no DST) and others in Europe. Can we show UTC along with local examples so people know what to expect during DST transitions?
Jordan Lee: Good idea. I'll update the event description to show example conversions: "09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST / 02:00 AEST (UTC 16:00)" and add a note about AZ not observing DST. Also added text: "If you see the wrong link in your calendar, join the APAC repeat link above or DM Maya to have the event forwarded."
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Quick recap: main orientation stays as scheduled, APAC repeat created (link in thread), .ics attached for Outlook imports, recordings will be posted here and to the drive, retention requested for 180 days. DM me if you want the invite forwarded. Welcome aboard! :party_parrot:
